text.tspan: Study note: nights are finite, so priorities
have to be honest.
Someone wrote, "What does good look like by
Friday?"
I answered with the messy truth. I failed one
quiz and learned more from that than the ones
I passed.
Adult learning works when life logistics are
respected.

I chose electives that stretch me, not ones
that pad the GPA easily.
Education is a long game dressed up as short
assignments.
I print the syllabus and highlight deadlines
like a project plan.
Credentials open doors. Curiosity keeps you in
the room.
